Engine fit function for divergence_classifier()

Source: R/parsnip.R
sitsar_divergence_fit.Rd

Internal fit function used by the 'parsnip' engines; it is exported only so that 'parsnip' can call it.

Usage

sitsar_divergence_fit(
  x,
  y,
  family = "gaussian",
  divergence = "renyi",
  order = 0.5,
  kind = 1
)

Arguments

x

Data frame of predictors.

y

Factor of classes.

family

"gaussian" or "wishart".

divergence, order, kind

See divergence_classifier().

Value

A fitted DivergenceClassifier.
